NaAudio__Space__Meta.Name: First Space
NaAudio__Space__Meta.Description: The demonstration arrangement AudioSPACE opens with. A circular sequencer on a CR-78 kit, a CubeMod playing a pentatonic figure through its own synth voice, and a DelayCloud processing both. Authored as data rather than as a bootstrap function, so a new arrangement is a JSON edit.
NaAudio__Space__Meta.Author: Adam Noble - Noble Architecture
NaAudio__Space__Meta.LayoutNote: Positions are in metres on the ground plane, with the listener at the origin. The three modules sit on a ring facing the centre, roughly 4.5 metres out - close enough to read a step from the middle of the space, far enough apart that no two cages overlap.

Settings.PatternNote: One character per division, read left to right from twelve o'clock clockwise. 'x' is a hit and '.' is a rest. Written this way so the pattern is legible at a glance in an editor - an array of sixteen booleans is not.

Settings.SelfPlayNote: A CubeMod is a controller, so on its own it is silent and impossible to evaluate. Set false to stop it playing its own walking figure and drive it from a sequencer instead.

Settings.SeedNote: Seeds the sphere start positions and velocities, so this space reopens looking as it was left rather than rescattered.

NaAudio__Space__Cables.Note: The sequencer's drums into the enclosure, so resizing the box audibly changes the space the kit sits in.
Two sources into one effect, which is what the design manifest asks the routing to support.
